run_bloat_syms_mode: run bloat.py in syms mode to generate JSON treemap from nm output for binary size analysis
run_bloat_dump_mode: run bloat.py in dump mode to print symbols sorted by size from nm output
run_bloat_sections_mode: run bloat.py in sections mode to generate JSON treemap from objdump section headers
parse_nm_output: parse nm output lines into symbol name, type, size, and source file path tuples
treeify_and_jsonify_syms: treeify nm symbols into a hierarchical directory tree and jsonify for treemap visualization
